# 3d-hex-cluster

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Honeycomb of outlined hexagon cells around a central disc. Backdrop: White to pale grey. Items: 6 to 10. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Monochrome cool default: navy #1C2A4A, teal #1FB5C8 and pale blue #9DD3E8 for the layered rims; white #FFFFFF cell faces; charcoal #2B2F36 icons and text; teal hub title
- Family variant: one family colour per cell on the outer rim, inner rims stay grey
- White to pale grey studio backdrop, faint soft shadow under each cell and under the hub

## Visual elements

- Hexagons flat-topped, equal size, sharing edges in a honeycomb; two or three thin outline rims offset outward like contour lines
- Each cell: line icon at the top, bold caps name, two-line light description, all centred
- Hub disc 25 to 30 percent of the shorter canvas side, white face, grey bevel ring, optional second thin ring outside
- Connectors: thin charcoal lines with a right-angle bend, dot terminal at the cell end, dot on the hub rim
- Cells overlap the hub slightly at the inner edge to read as one assembly

## Typography

- Family typography; cell names bold caps in charcoal, descriptions light and small, hub title bold caps in the accent colour

## Composition rules

- Six to ten cells; two honeycomb columns flanking the hub (landscape); ring of cells around the hub (square); hub at the top with the honeycomb below (portrait)
- Fewer than six cells, switch to 3d-capsule-hub; more than ten, switch to 3d-paper-tile
- Connectors never cross; route each to the nearest free point on the hub rim
- Keep text inside the cell; nothing spills past the outer rim

## Layout

### Structure

- Hub disc centred, 25 to 30 percent of the shorter canvas side
- Six to ten equal hexagon cells sharing edges in honeycomb columns
- Each cell: icon at the top, name, short description
- Connectors from each cell to the hub rim, never crossing
- Optional category grouping by rim colour

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Twin columns** | Items around one platform | Two honeycomb columns flanking the hub |
| **Ring** | Square canvas, even weight | Cells circle the hub |
| **Hubless honeycomb** | Interlocking parts, no centre | Cells share edges edge to edge, no connectors |
| **Grouped honeycomb** | Categories | Outer rim colour per group, cells clustered by group |

### Visual Elements

- Flat-topped hexagons, two or three thin concentric outline rims
- Line icon in charcoal or the rim colour
- Hub with a white face and grey bevel ring
- Thin connectors with a right-angle bend and dot terminals
- Cells overlap the hub edge slightly to read as one assembly

### Text Placement

- Title in the hub, two lines maximum
- Cell name bold caps under the icon
- Two-line description under the name, inside the cell
- Group labels outside the honeycomb when grouped
- Nothing spills past the outer rim
